name: Build System Diagnosis
description: Explain a build failure from the generator and the error, then change only the failing part.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
See the application layout before changing it.
Find the code, docs, or config the task names.
Locate a build or config file by name.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.

validation.rule: The failing target and the build system were named from the log and the project files.
